title: Horizon Europe Joint Undertakings
description: All 10 institutionalised European Partnerships under Horizon Europe established by Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085
legal_basis: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085 establishing the Joint Undertakings under Horizon Europe

joint_undertakings.name: Circular Bio-based Europe Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title I
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: Strategic Innovation and Research Agenda (SIRA) 2021-2031: bio-based solutions for climate-neutral, circular economy

joint_undertakings.name: Clean Aviation Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title II
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: SRIA for Clean Aviation: climate-neutral aviation by 2050
joint_undertakings.private_partners: Clean Aviation founding members (Airbus, Safran, Rolls-Royce, MTU, Dassault, Leonardo, GKN, Liebherr, and others)
key_programmes: Disruptive technologies (new configurations, sustainable aviation fuels integration)

joint_undertakings.name: Clean Hydrogen Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title III
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: SRIA for Clean Hydrogen: accelerate development and deployment of clean hydrogen technologies
joint_undertakings.private_partners: Hydrogen Europe (industry) and Hydrogen Europe Research (research)
key_programmes: Fuel cells for transport and stationary applications
joint_undertakings.predecessor: Fuel Cells and Hydrogen 2 Joint Undertaking (FCH2 JU)

joint_undertakings.name: European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: European HPC strategy: world-class supercomputing infrastructure and ecosystem
joint_undertakings.private_partners: European Technology Platform for HPC (ETP4HPC) and Big Data Value Association (BDVA/DAIRO)

budget_2021_2027.eu_contribution: EUR 3.5 billion (from Digital Europe + Horizon Europe + CEF)
budget_2021_2027.private_contribution: Participating states and private partners match EU contribution

joint_undertakings.name: Europe's Rail Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title IV
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: System Pillar Master Plan: single European railway area, digitalisation, decarbonisation
joint_undertakings.private_partners: Rail industry founding members (Alstom, Siemens, Bombardier/Alstom, Thales, Hitachi Rail, CAF, Stadler, infrastructure managers)

joint_undertakings.name: Global Health EDCTP3 Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title V
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: Strategic Research and Innovation Agenda for clinical trials in sub-Saharan Africa on poverty-related diseases
joint_undertakings.member_states_participation: 14 EU participating states + 31 sub-Saharan African countries
joint_undertakings.private_partners: BMGF (Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation) as contributing partner
key_programmes: Phase II/III clinical trials for infectious diseases (HIV, TB, malaria, NTDs)
Capacity building for clinical research in Africa
Product-oriented research for diagnostics, drugs, vaccines

joint_undertakings.name: Innovative Health Initiative Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title VI
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: SRIA for health innovation: translating health research into tangible benefits for patients and society
joint_undertakings.private_partners: COCIR, EFPIA, EuropaBio, MedTech Europe, Vaccines Europe
key_programmes: Digital tools for health (AI, real-world data, health data spaces)

joint_undertakings.name: Key Digital Technologies Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title VII
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: ECS-SRIA: Electronic Components and Systems for European leadership in digital technologies
joint_undertakings.member_states_participation: All EU Member States eligible + national funding authorities contribute
key_programmes: Semiconductor manufacturing and design (Chips Act synergies)

joint_undertakings.name: Single European Sky ATM Research 3 Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title VIII
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: Digital European Sky: modernisation of European air traffic management
joint_undertakings.member_states_participation: All EU Member States eligible + Eurocontrol as founding member
joint_undertakings.private_partners: Air navigation service providers, airports, airlines, aerospace manufacturers, Eurocontrol
key_programmes: Automation and AI for air traffic control

joint_undertakings.name: Smart Networks and Services Joint Undertaking
joint_undertakings.founding_regulation: Council Regulation (EU) 2021/2085, Part Two, Title IX
joint_undertakings.strategic_research_agenda: 5G/6G SRIA: European leadership in next-generation networks and services
joint_undertakings.private_partners: 6G-IA (6G Smart Networks and Services Industry Association, formerly 5G-IA/NetWorld2020)
key_programmes: Smart connectivity for verticals (industry, health, transport, energy)

common_governance.governing_board: Representatives of all members (EU, participating states, private partners)
common_governance.executive_director: Appointed by Governing Board, manages day-to-day operations
common_governance.scientific_advisory_body: Independent experts advising on research priorities
common_governance.states_representatives_group: Member State delegates for national coordination
common_governance.stakeholders_group: Broader stakeholder input (open call for expressions of interest)

common_rules.financial_regulation: EU Financial Regulation 2018/1046 applies (adapted for JUs)
common_rules.staff_regulations: EU Staff Regulations apply to JU staff
common_rules.grant_management: Horizon Europe Model Grant Agreement (MGA) for funded projects
common_rules.audit: ECA audit + internal audit capability + Commission OLAF access
common_rules.evaluation: Mid-term and final evaluations by Commission (Art. 171 Horizon Europe Regulation)
